docs: docs/snooze.md § Conformance vectors. Language-neutral schemas for all six vector groups. Row-model phase populates and executes rows/when/live; mutation-planners completes snooze/wake/cleanup without silently skipping unknown cases (unknown group, runner, or mode is a hard error in the typed loader).

schemas.rows: input: {note: string (LF or CRLF daily note), encoding: 'lf'|'crlf'}; expected: {header: number|null (1-based), duplicates: number[] (1-based), rows: [{line, kind: 'active'|'history'|'malformed', hhmm|null, target|null, block|null, embedded: bool, aliased: bool, children: number (count of note-subtree lines), malformed_reason|null, woke|null}]}
schemas.when: input: {input: string, date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', now: 'HH:MM', zone: IANA name}; expected: {hhmm, minutes, rfc3339_contains} | {refusal: 'past'|'next_day'|'dst_gap'|'invalid'}
schemas.live: input: {today: 'YYYY-MM-DD', note_date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', now: 'HH:MM', rows: [{line, minutes|null, history: bool, malformed: bool, resolution: 'found'|'missing'|'ambiguous', route|null, block|null, status|null, is_task: bool, is_event: bool, live_link: bool}]}; expected: {states: [{line, state}], planned: string[] ('route#^block'), blocked: string[], next_wake_at_contains|null, event_lints: number[]}
schemas.snooze: input: {day, when?, now, date, zone, task: {path, contents, line (1-based), route, block, target, status, is_task, is_event, blocked, type_key, type_name, link}}; mode: 'add'|'drop'; expected: {refusal|null, day, task?, task_unchanged?}
schemas.wake: input: {day, now, date, zone, tasks: [task], explicit?: [{route, block}], link_count?, max_links?}; mode: 'wake'; expected: {day, woken?: [{block, destination, created}], over?, tasks_unchanged?, second_wake_empty?}
schemas.cleanup: input: {day, now, date, zone, tasks: [task]}; mode: 'cleanup'; expected: {day}
